statement: You are given an array nums whose every element is 0, 1 or 2.
Sort nums in place into non-decreasing order, so that all 0s come first, then all 1s, then all 2s, without calling a library sort.
Return the sorted array. A single pass with constant extra space is possible.

examples.explanation: There are two of each value, so the sorted array is two 0s, two 1s and two 2s.
One of each value, placed in order.
